firstPlayerRule: Choose the first Captain at random. They receive the Compass marker and Action dice, roll the dice, and decide which die controls the morning and evening actions.
clarifications: After everyone secretly chooses an Action card, the Captain reveals and resolves theirs first. After the round, pass the Compass marker to the player on the left.
